maintenance_rules: Visualization is observability, never implementation proof.
Blueprint presence is documentation, never implementation proof.
A test file counts as verification evidence only if CI actually invokes it.
A live shell/runtime is wired only if the current dashboard/router imports or calls it.
Dashboard rebuilds must preserve Pulse Beam shell imports and independent component hooks.
Failures are classified as logic, wiring/integration drift, verification gap, documentation drift, or visual/observability gap.
Every visualized system declares visual_state and owner in this register; the Citadel does not infer green health from geometry.
Formal MaintenanceReceipt is observation evidence only; it cannot mint or upgrade Funnel authority.
